name: sol8-usage-preview-fit
goal: Show hidden consumers at a zero limit and keep usage previews inside their owner without covering its title.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Zero-limit footers must distinguish hidden consumers from an empty list; fixed usage previews must fit their owner and leave its title visible.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard catalog checked hidden overflow text and tooltip content but not painted zero-limit text, owner edges or title intersection. Extend those existing assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final record 9dbef82290 at b2c3db264f fails all nine owner-fit and readable-count cases. Earlier 3eaa1c3e0a failed six geometry cases but admitted clipped labels.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 30f1333351 and 01d4afec70 show zero-limit counts and anchor previews inside the containing card, away from its title.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final green record at 01d4afec70 passes all nine unchanged state/viewport assertions; final red 9dbef82290 fails all nine.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
